defect.description: The frozen audit unconditionally requires recovery-v2, although V4 has no recovery config and recomputes all affected internal arms.
defect.expected_failure: FileNotFoundError for an inapplicable recovery-v2 stage

runtime_shim.scope: Preserve all release privacy, denylist, source/config hash, input canary, and actual V4 stage-manifest checks; remove only the V3-only recovery-v2 prerequisite.

acceptance_rule: Use the shim only after aggregate release; any privacy, denylist, canary, source hash, or actual V4 stage check failure remains a hard stop.
